name: Lipari flash flood
headline: Upper trough from the west: 500 hPa heights fell 5,825 to 5,687 m.
numbers: None reported in the sources we read (Italian outlets, 10 Oct)

sections.The setup: Record summer Mediterranean heat; sea 25.7 °C on 3 Oct.
sections.The trigger: Upper trough from the west: 500 hPa heights fell 5,825 to 5,687 m.
sections.What amplified it: CAPE 1,850–2,280 J/kg; short steep volcanic torrents through built-up channels. Models gave only ~5 mm/h.
sections.Climate signal: No study; warmer sea feeds autumn storms (physical reasoning).
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
